body.intent: A leaf's retry prompt carries the verifier's findings verbatim and says to inspect the working tree and address every finding as written; builders and verifiers append one-line learnings to the run's notes, which later leaves' prompts carry; builders update landed nodes their leaf changes or raise a question. Evidence: 113 of 368 leaves needed a second attempt, 36 model-check majors were drift (prompt-gap recs 9-11).
body.title: Verbatim retry and run notes
